helpDraw: d                        deal one card from the stock (no redeal)
helpMoveTF: m t <pile> f             tableau to foundation
helpMoveTT: m t <from> t <to>        move one card onto a bare king
bareKingPile: (king only - any card may be placed)
hintDeal: Hint: deal another card from the stock
undoToEscape: You need to undo {{count}} move(s) to escape (undo {{count}}, or repeat u)
helpExampleHint: h                        ask for the next move
helpExampleAuto: ac                       send every card that can go to a foundation
errStockEmptyNoRedeal: The stock is empty (this game has no redeal)
errNoFoundationForCard: No foundation accepts that card (ace up to jack, any suit; a foundation whose column is not open yet cannot be used)
errSamePile: The source and destination columns are the same
errKingIsTheBase: The king at the base of a column cannot be moved
errCannotPlaceOnPile: That column will not take that card (only a column holding just its king will)
errNothingToAutoComplete: No card can be sent to a foundation automatically
errNothingToUndo: There is no move to undo
errNotPlaying: The game is not in progress
